widgets.css:
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;color:#eef2f8;font:14px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif}body{background:transparent}.card{padding:16px;border:1px solid #37465b;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#1d2a3b,#141d29)}h1,h2,p{margin:0}h1{font-size:48px;line-height:1.08;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.04em}h2{font-size:18px;font-weight:600}.muted,label,small{color:#b0bfd1}.top,.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}.row{margin-top:10px}input,textarea,button,select{font:inherit;border:1px solid #455a74;border-radius:10px;min-height:44px;padding:10px;color:#eef2f8;background:#0f1b2a}input,textarea{min-width:0;width:100%}button{cursor:pointer;background:#b9dcff;color:#10263b;font-weight:600}button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}.secondary{background:#24364d;color:#dbeaff}.status{margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:#b0bfd1;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin-top:10px}.grid button{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px}.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:14px 0}.metrics strong{display:block;font-size:22px}.metrics span{font-size:12px;color:#b0bfd1}a{color:#b9dcff}textarea{resize:none;min-height:74px;margin-top:10px}label{font-size:12px}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8fc5ff;outline-offset:2px}[hidden]{display:none!important}body{padding:8px 0}.card{margin-bottom:12px}.card:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.grid button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}.grid button span{max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.grid button img{object-fit:contain;flex:none}
